recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與凝塊切片中巨核細胞數量增加、體積大且核分葉過多（hyperlobated），而網狀纖維染色未見明顯纖維化，搭配持續血小板增多，符合原發性血小板增多症樣表現（本例為 JAK2 R564Q 家族性）。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with trilineage hematopoiesis and several megakaryocytes at low power
Large megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and hyperlobated/hypersegmented nuclei
Clot section: megakaryocytes with large, deeply lobulated nuclei loosely scattered among hematopoietic cells and fat
No obvious atypical clustering or bare hyperchromatic megakaryocyte nuclei
Reticulin stain shows no significant increase in fibers
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with trilineage hematopoiesis and increased megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are large with abundant granular cytoplasm and hyperlobulated nuclei. Clot sections show a cellular marrow with scattered large, hyperlobated megakaryocytes, without significant clustering. Reticulin stain shows no significant fibrosis. Findings are consistent with a thrombocytosis with essential thrombocythemia-like megakaryocytic morphology, correlating with the familial JAK2 R564Q variant.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal in size and lobation, not the giant hyperlobulated forms seen here.

Pre-PMF shows hypercellularity with granulocytic proliferation and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei, rather than loosely dispersed staghorn megakaryocytes.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf forms) with marked granulocytic hyperplasia, and BCR::ABL1 is present.
Morphology overlaps with ET, so family studies and germline sequencing are needed to distinguish inherited from sporadic clonal disease.
